caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object positioned diagonally across a plain, light-colored background. The object consists of a rectangular box with a slanted top lid secured by a central looped handle. There are visible fasteners, likely screws or rivets, securing the lid to the box. Attached to the side of the box is a long, slender handle extending horizontally to the right, ending in a small circular hole. The overall color scheme of the drawing is grayscale, with shading used to indicate texture, shadows, and the three-dimensionality of the object. The box itself appears to have an opening or hinged section on the side facing the viewer, revealing a dark interior. The composition centers the object in the left half of the frame, with the handle stretching towards the right, and there is a small handwritten text “JACOB” located beneath the box.
title: Hot Coal Carrier
